reason: The criterion is about which names src/index.ts exports. Breaking it means removing an export, which a witness calling an exported function cannot show, and mutants must not change exports.
The exported types Cart, Line, Coupon and Breakdown are erased at runtime, so no exported function can show their absence.
The Coupon union shape is a type-level definition erased at runtime, so no exported function output can differ.
The Breakdown field list is a type-level definition erased at runtime, and mutants must not change types.
Erasable-syntax-only is a property of the source text and compiler settings, not of any value an exported function returns.

The criterion is about which invalid field the ValidationError names when several are invalid. A witness compares only the error class (expectedError), so it cannot show that the wrong or a valid field was named, and any input with several invalid fields is already rejected by the single-field criteria 3.1 to 3.3.
